I love this game! I struggle with and have a slow reaction time, but, Hi-Fi makes following the rhythm so easy that the quick time events and building combos is so easy. I actually look forward to the quick time events, especially the parrying. This is the only game where I will actively try and parry and opponent, it's that easy compared to other games!

The humor is also really fun and light hearted while being a bit cheeky and self aware. It's a good blend that over all makes all the characters really fun and likable and I'm hooked on the story as a result!
Uma obra prima de campanha, jogos como Crypt of the Necrodancer andaram para q Hi-Fi Rush pudesse correr, em termos de misturar ação e ritmo sem prejudicar nenhum gênero. Fantástico.

An awesome fun game! I haven't played DMC games so this was my first game with this style. Music is awesome, story and characters are good and charming. More fun games like these please!

Action game and Rhythm game at the same time, definitely a learning curve but the game is absurdly fun. It's worth every penny and then some.

So I guess my problem is that a rhythm game has too much repetition... I can see why people seem to like it a lot, but it really didn't do much for me. The same combat encounters over and over were really tiring. I guess platforming was kinda ok, but not great. Really basic story with no surprises. Flat, generic characters, despite the great voice acting. It's by no means terrible, but I also struggle to find anything to really recommend.

One of the best rhythm games I have ever played, and I played quite a few of those!
The combat is smooth and extremely fun, the writing is funny and the cell-shaded graphics look beautiful.
Oh, and the music, of course, I know this is expected but this soundtrack still has to be mentioned, it's freaking amazing!

This game is just genuine fun from start to finish, great story, characters, and style! The combat is satisfying to get the hang of and hits great when your jamming with the music, it's also got a good bit of replayability, definitely pick it up if it looks interesting to you, it's worth it.

One of the best games I've ever played. The story, characters, world, combat, the art style and animations, it's all done with such care. Oh and cosmetics are earned the good old fashioned way: in-game by accumulating readily available currency over time as opposed to a bunch of "micro" transactions.

10/10!
PLEASE buy this at full price if only to incentive companies to release more shadow drops. Hype kills.

Do you like Dmc? Do you like rythem games? do you have skill? no? still buy this, even with a no skill goblin like me can have fun with this game, the story is simple, even if there are some fps drops when the anime like cutsceans pop up

This game is a good time if you even mildly enjoy rhythm games. The art direction is great; the world moves to the beat... and while it is also just a perfect fit for its comic book artstyle; it also helps you keep track of the beat no matter where you are looking. I found with other rhythm games, I was too busy looking at a beat indicator to appreciate the visuals sometimes, but with the visuals being the beat indicator themselves I can fully enjoy the game.

The game's story is simple and funny; it's a great way to spend a weekend or two. Even though I have beat the game on gamepass, I wanted to own it to replay it because this is the type of game that you'll get the urge to pick up again after some time.

Xbox dissolving the studio behind this game was a mistake. They're also behind the Evil Within games which are also decent games. If talent and creativity like this gets rewarded with a layoff, then I guess we're doomed to half-baked sequels like Halo Infinite for the rest of our future.

Hi-fi rush ? Gameplay wise It's kinda devil may cry + guitar hero + a touch of platformer.

Fights ? Acrobatic, responsive, based on short combos that you have to remember (easy enough), then progressively sync to the beat. As a musician I'm so used to tap my foot to all sorts of songs that i find Hifi's combat immediately rewarding. Higher difficulties are probably quite challenging (I'm playing in "normal mode" for my 1st run) but the game strives to be accessible and welcoming to aspiring rockstars.

You will visit a colorful fantasy world that's actually slightly dystopian but lighthearted humor and a cheerful atmosphere may well put a smile on your face.

Thanks Tango Gameworks for staying away from bleakness this time around and making a game I can EN-JOY.

Played it with Game Pass but nothing beats the steam experience.

Any game that has a reference to Saturn Devouring his Son by Francisco Goya deserves some sort of award.
Amazing gameplay, fantastic characters and a very charming story managed to put this as my GOTY.

Update: as if they couldn't make the game any better. Denuvo and any affiliation with Bethesda got removed.
I'm still concerned about Krafton as a publisher but for now the game is in a better state than it was under Microsoft.
One of the most unique and incredible games! Oozing with style and charm. Genuinely couldn't stop smiling during my playthrough.

Fantastic game that doesn't overstay its welcome, with a healthy post-game if you feel up for more once you're done. Supremely confident work from a developer at the top of their game, released at a very reasonable price. Absolutely criminal that Microsoft has shut down Tango.

Turns out that performing actions to the beat of the music makes things really stylish. Unlike in some other rhythm combat games such as Metal:Hellsinger or Patapon, the enemies in Hi-Fi Rush move and attack to the beat as well! This lets you dodge, parry, and attack to the music and it feels satisfying.

The story is super cheesy but it's presented very well. All the characters and enemies are great. The whole campaign is very memorable. I'm still having fun past the main story as there are still more secrets to find and challenges to undertake and I am enjoying playing more to complete them because the gameplay is addicting.

I dont buy very many games on Steam that are not on discount but I did this time and I'm glad I did. This games visually looks amazing and is very fun to play... I'm still getting use to all the rhythm elements but I plan on spending several hours rockin though this game. I would definitely recommend it.

This game is forever going to have that feeling of wonder and joy when i first played it, not knowing anything about it aside that it was developed by same folks behind the evil within.
If i didnt have a Steam Deck I'd be sad to miss it, my roomies do have an Xbox series but man i needed this game. Anytime i'm having a bad day i know which game to resort to having a jamming good time.

GOTY from me 10/10 Radical vibes all around

I really liked Hi-Fi Rush, from the get go i had heard nothing but good things. I really liked Tango Gameworks other games and this one looked like their freshest yet (R.I.P guys). The game has an incredibly pleasing and vibrant world, it pops with so much colour and energy, A Huge aspect of the game is keeping to the rhythm and beat which in turn effects the world, it all plays to the beat. The characters are fun and all likeable and the world has alot of life too it. 

Now i am not the best at keeping to the beat especially as with other Hack n Slashs where I am abit more of a button masher, trying to keep combat to the beat is surprisngly hard BUT i did get better. I think in all i just feel there is alot of heart in this game and reminds me of a really solid indie title, which if it were one i would absolutely ignore any short comings.

The most me-core game I have played in a long time.
Saddest I've ever been finishing a videogame.

Cartoonish! Cool characters! Devil May Cry sort of combat but synced to music! In fact you tend to pick up combos naturally due to the world around you grooving to the same beat.

Comparatively easier to run on even low end builds! Also, no bugs!

There are very few things to dislike in this one. It has a short run through but its absolutely worth it.

Don't you think it's funny that after making one of the best, funnest, humorous games of 2023 with the best art style, characters, gameplay and music of any game I have seen for a long time, winning a game award AND a BAFTA, that the very next year the studio is shut down so that Bethesda can focus on "bigger projects", meaning AAA games broken on launch that no one really likes and will probably be forgotten in 3 years. RIP Tango Gameworks.

I've played this game on normal and beat it in 10 hrs but there are plenty more challenges to go through! I highly recommend this to anyone looking to mash buttons to a beat while enjoying a well crafted world!

This game is such a delight, everything just works together so well. The music enhances the gameplay and tone of the story, the gameplay reenforces the characterization displayed in the cut scenes, the world is just littered with jokes about the workplace that anyone not born with a multi-million dollar trust fund will find hilariously relatable (and a little depressing about the state of the global economy it you think to much about it). Is it a perfect game? Heck No! Something about the camera placement and visual design makes platforming stupidly difficult for reasons I’m not smart enough to understand, and the difficulty ‘curve’ is more of a difficulty seismograph, with challenges swinging wildly from not knowing what’s going on while struggling to get good to feeling like I was back in the tutorial. However it’s still very good gameplay despite its flaws, I had a smile plastered to my face while playing it, and was giggling openly about its witty writing every few minutes.

Amazing shadow dropped game by Shinji Mikami's studio! Fighting robots and bosses to the beat was an absolute blast! That Xenogears reference came right outta nowhere, I need to know who came up with that. There's still more side content that I haven't gotten to yet so I'll give that a try. Either way, this game was robbed at the 2023 Game Awards.

As an 10+ years drummer, I was quite disappointed. The gameplay felt very limited — essentially one beat and two attacks. The combos look visually impressive, but aside from the simple combat (choose hardest diff) there’s almost nothing else to do. For me, that just isn’t enough.

finally beat this game and i will admit it was amazing would've been nice to see this game company make more games but sadly they got shut down however this is truly a remarkable game and love playing it

Hi-Fi Rush is a perfect game. It really has it all:

Amazing gameplay. Satisfying, fun, the kind that makes you wanna play the game whenever you think about it.
The perfect length. Enough to explore all its mechanics, tell a coherent story, and end at just the right spot.
Incredible sound. Nothing like dynamic soundtrack to make a fight exciting.
Superb art direction. I mean, look at it, this game will never age.
Memorable characters. I love every one of them. They all have their moment. They're amazing.
Pure passion and creativity. Remember when big studio games felt unique, original, unafraid of taking risks? They could have just made something more akin to Evil Within or Ghostwire Tokyo, yet this is a total 180.
On top of all that, add the impeccable script. This is one of the funniest games ever written. I can't believe how many of the jokes land.

This game is already a classic. It is an outstanding achievement and it deserved better.
Thank you everyone who worked at Tango. Shame this was your last dance, but damn it was a great one.

I can see why this was left as a surprise launch; it's at its best when it's constantly surprising you with so many nice touches that you don't see coming.

incredible visual and sound design, over-the-top and silly characters, super solid gameplay. did the whole game on hard and i definitely died quite a bit but nothing ever felt impassable and the checkpoints are very forgiving. roughly 10hrs to beat but i spent a lot of time running around finding collectibles so if you're just speedrunning that could be shorter

This is one of those games that are so unbelievably good, you're shocked it even exists. Packs so much into such a tight bundle, leaves you overjoyed and wanting more. Not only from this game, this company, but the even the medium it belongs in. We need more games like this - especially now. Ones with no filler, with no bullshit, just pure and true entertainment start to finish. It'll go down as one of the greats, one that inspires other games to pursue excellence as it has.

I don't remember the last time I felt I underpaid for a game.

Everything about this game, art design, music, dialogue, controls and game play, was clearly made with love from people who are passionate about video games. Whether it's the satisfaction of wiping out a group of enemies with an absurd combo or that moment when you fight a boss to a NIN song, this game slaps from here to the edge of the universe.

Don't wait for it to go on sale. Hi-Fi Rush is more than worth every penny.

A rhythm-based action game that's very forgiving with the timing. Runs extremely well on Steam Deck OLED. The characters are loveable, the story a hilarious romp, and the pacing of adding characters, mechanics, and boss fights is superb. I never once felt like I couldn't overcome the challenge presented in each level. While not a game I would immediately jump back into to play at a higher difficulty, I will certainly be revisiting in the future when I have an itch to play a rhythm-based game.

Game doesnt take itself too seriously, its a nice change of pace from all the current games that are already out. It is very forgiving on the lower difficulties so even people like me can enjoy the game for what it has. 9.5/10
I wish the game was longer
This game is a lot of fun. Once i understood the controls, i was ready to go back and beat more levels and/or mini games. I would recommend for sure. its an awesome rhythm game

Have you ever wanted to play DMC/Bayonetta as a rhythm game?
The gameplay depth is on the level of Nero with the addition of Bayonetta style combo finishers and "assists" you can call during battle for different effects.
The enemies are varied and challenging, going from combo fodder to actual minibosses.
The beat mechanic is very fun, playing on rhythm will reward you with style points and a hefty damage boost.
AND THE SOUNDTRACK! Absolute bangers from start to finish.

If you like character action games, get this game.
If you like rhythm games, get this game.
If you like good innovative gameplay designs, get this game.
Get this game.
Has a good soundtrack and gameplay. Dialogue is depending on your kind of humor a hit or miss. Art style and animation is very good. It's a pretty good time honestly.
